scientific_integrity: The genus-three diagonal Hasse--Witt matrix is proved symbolically. Characteristic-thirteen Newton slopes use a separable degree-nine elliptic decomposition. Computer output corroborates exact algebra and is not used to infer infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification of the marked coefficient family in characteristic thirteen and first occurrence among tame odd primes at most thirteen; not a classification of isomorphism classes or arbitrary characteristic. Originality remains subject to historical priority checking.
title: The first rank-one Newton stratum in a dihedral genus-three pencil
